title: Own-time answering screen
story: I can now answer a ticket in my own time from one screen. I can type answers into a form and press Done, or start a grilling agent whose tab shows my questions and a Done button beside the terminal. I can also paste or upload a meeting transcript for the ticket and the agent uses it. Before this, the own-time screen showed 'not built yet'.

checks.criterion: Form answers go through the store with the answer markers
checks.steps: From Tickets, open made-up 'Sample ticket 4', which has 3 questions. Type 'Sample answer.' under the second question and press Save answer.
checks.expected: That question turns 'Answered' and shows 'Sample answer.', and the heading shows 'Taken by you'.

checks.criterion: Done with open questions releases the ticket
checks.steps: Answer only some questions of 'Sample ticket 4', then press Done.
checks.expected: 'Sample ticket 4 is back in the pool, unlocked. N question(s) … still open and visible to everyone.' and the list of questions with their badges.

checks.criterion: Done with all answered closes the ticket, and mapDone starts /grillo-prd
checks.steps: Answer every question of the last open ticket (no fog left), then press Done.
checks.expected: 'All questions answered. Sample ticket 4 is closed…', a 'Map done' row, and a new 'Grilling · PRD' tab.

checks.criterion: The agent variant is hosted in the agent tab
checks.steps: On the ticket, press 'With a grilling agent'.
checks.expected: The tab 'Grilling · Sample ticket 4' opens with the terminal typing '/grillo-answer <n>', the ticket heading above it and the Questions card with Done on the right.

checks.criterion: Done types done into the agent
checks.expected: 'done' appears in the terminal, the note 'Done sent…' shows, and Done greys out; after the agent finishes, the outcome note appears. Then 'In a form' and Done closes or releases the ticket itself.

checks.criterion: A pasted or uploaded transcript is submitted with use it
checks.steps: In the agent tab press 'Import a transcript (paste or upload)'. Paste two made-up lines, or upload a .txt file, then press Use it.
checks.expected: The lines appear in the terminal followed by 'use it', then the note 'Transcript sent with "use it"…'.
